test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Scarcely had I reached the terrace to water my plants ______ two monkeys jumped in front of me.
solution:
The correct answer is "**when**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the conjunction **"when**" to connect the two clauses of the sentence.
 
• "**When**" is a subordinate clause that substantiates the main clause of the sentence with additional information.
 
• Subordinating conjunction is also used to show a **cause and effect relationship.**
 
• We also "**when**" to talk about the completion of a shorter event when a longer event is still going on.
 
• The use of when implies "**at that time**". It is crucial to mark the time when an event occurred.
 
• It is also known as time-related conjunction.
 
 
• **Example**: *The phone bell rang **when **I was just about to leave the house.*
 
 

**The correct sentence is**: *Scarcely had I reached the terrace to water my plants **when**__ two monkeys jumped in front of me.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.
